div.div:
Under event+campaign lock: redemption count + active reservation count < max before new
allowance; refund leaves redemptions intact. One active reservation per hold and one
redemption per order.
ENFORCEMENT: DDL + TX
REFERENCE: uq_active_promo_hold; TX-05/08/17

Percent eligible lines only; fixed discount once per order; no stacking.

REFERENCE: TX-07/08
